verdict.rationale: ImageMagick's own docs claim a 'scripting-first design for mass batch jobs', but the only concrete examples convert a single file at a time. The community report of processing thousands of images used a user-written bash script, which is a user-side workaround and earns no credit. Missing for 10: a documented single-command folder or file-list conversion (no batch mode such as mogrify appears in the evidence), per-file success/failure results or reporting, and hands-on corroboration of native batch runs.
